RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Thursday, September 8, 2011/Bhadra 17, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Prime Minister; Atomic Energy; Civil Aviation; Development of
North Eastern Region; External Affairs; Overseas Indian Affairs;
Panchayati Raj; Personnel, Public Grievances and Pensions;
Planning; Road Transport and Highways; Shipping;
Social Justice and Empowerment; Space; Steel;
Tourism; Tribal Affairs; Women and Child
Development; Youth Affairs and Sports)
Total number of questions — 20
145
Report of the National
Transport Development
Policy Committee
*501. DR. JANARDHAN W AGH-
MARE: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether as per a report prepared by
the National Transport Development
Policy Committee, poor maintenance of
roads costs the country about Rs. 35,000
crore annually;
(b) if so, the reaction of Government/
NHAI on the report of the Committee;
(c) whether Government proposes to
take any effective measures to ensure that
the roads are maintained in an efficient
manner by changing policy etc.; and
(d) if so, further steps that Government
proposes to take in this regard?
Article 275(1) of the Constitution
*502. SHRI KANJIBHAI PA TEL: Will
the Minister of TRIBAL AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether purpose of Article 275(1)
of the Constitution has been fully fulfilled;
and
(b) if not, the reasons therefor?
Budgetary allocation to CIC
*503. SHRI MOINUL HASSAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of the budgetary
allocation to the Central Information
Commission (CIC) for the past three years;
(b) whether Government is aware that
the staff for the CIC is inadequate to
dispose of the pending number of cases;
(c) if so, whether Government intends
to increase allocation to the said Office in
the next year;

146
(d) if not, whether Government has
conducted a study of the bureaucratic
infrastructure in place at the CIC and
whether it intends to improve the same;
and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Establishment of Expressway
Authority
*504. SHRI NATUJI HALAJI
THAKOR: Will the Minister of ROAD
TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has proposed
to establish Expressway Authority, a novel
body to facilitate building of over 18,000
kms of roads catering to high speed traffic
on the pattern of National Highways
Authority of India (NHAI); and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the time-
frame proposed by Government for this
matter?
NOC for Navi Mumbai International
Airport
*505. SHRI TARIQ ANW AR: Will the
Minister of CIVIL A VIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Environment
Ministry has given No Objection
Certificate for Navi Mumbai International
Airport;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of the status of this
project; and
(d) how much time it will take to start
this project?
Improvement in aviation sector
*506. SHRI A VTAR SINGH
KARIMPURI: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has prepared
a road map for the development of civil
aviation sector as a whole for the country;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor;
(d) the steps taken to make air travel
affordable and hassle-free for the
passengers; and
(e) the details of other measures taken
to improve the efficiency of the aviation
sector with a view to meet global standard
and competition?
Construction of roads under EPC
system
†*507. SHRI RAM JETHMALANI:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that projects
related to construction of roads in the
country would be made under Engineering
Procurement and Contract (EPC) system
in place of Annuity System;
(b) if so, the details thereof, System-
wise;
(c) whether it is a fact that road
construction under Annuity System was
costly; and
(d) if so, the fact thereof and extent of
reduction expected in cost in construction
under the present system?
Power generated by atomic energy
†*508. SHRI RAMCHANDRA
PRASAD SINGH: Will the PRIME
MINISTER be pleased to state:
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

147
(a) whether it is a fact that electricity is
generated through atomic energy in the
world;
(b) if so, the percentage of electricity
generated from atomic energy in America,
England, Japan, Germany, Australia,
Switzerland, Iran, Gulf countries, China,
Pakistan, etc.; and
(c) the target fixed in India, in
percentage, for generating electricity
through atomic energy?
Planning process to reduce regional
imbalance
*509. SHRI MANGALA KISAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) the planning process adopted by
Government to reduce the regional
imbalance in the country;
(b) the number of pockets/regions of
the country that have been identified as
most backward regions or underdeveloped
regions like Bundelkhand region in the
country;
(c) whether Government would declare
those pockets as identified backward
regions; and
(d) if so, the details thereof, State-wise?
Commissioning of first phase of
Jaitapur nuclear project
*510. SHRI A. ELAV ARASAN: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the commissioning of the
first phase of the 9,900 MW Jaitapur
nuclear power project is delayed by one
year since the developer, Nuclear Power
Corporation (NPC) is upgrading the safety
application  in the wake of the Fukushima
disaster;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the first Evolutionary
Pressurised Reactor (EPR) of 1,650 MW
would be operational in 2018-19 instead of
the originally planned 2017-18; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Pending proposals for change in
airport name
*511. SHRI BALWINDER SINGH
BHUNDER: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of requests for change of
airport name pending with the Ministry;
(b) since when these requests are
pending;
(c) the reasons for delay in taking
decision on each request;
(d) by when the names would be
changed;
(e) whether passing of a Resolution by
Legislative Assembly in this regard has been
adopted as one of the criteria for changing
the airport name; and
(f) if so, the reasons for adopting such a
norm, particularly in view of the fact that
there is no such provision in the
Constitution or any of the statutes relating
to civil aviation?
MoU for investment in steel industry
*512. SHRI DHIRAJ PRASAD SAHU:
Will the Minister of STEEL be pleased to
state:
(a) the number of Memoranda of
Understanding signed between various
State Governments and private companies
for investment in steel sector during the
last three years and the current year;
(b) the number of mega projects being
implemented at present; and

148
(c) the total production capacity of each
plant proposed to be set up in the steel
sector?
Holiday Camp Island
*513. SHRI BHARATSINH
PRABHATSINH PARMAR: Will the
Minister of TOURISM be pleased to state:
(a) the implementation status of the
projects relating to conservation of heritage
and eco-tourism in the country including
the State of Gujarat; and
(b) the details of proposals received and
approved for the development of "Holiday
Camp Island" under the Product
Infrastructure and Destination
Development Scheme during the last three
years, year-wise and total amount released,
year-wise?
Amenities for delayed flights
*514. SHRI JAI PRAKASH
NARAYAN SINGH: Will the Minister of
CIVIL A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether recently Supreme Court has
directed Government to provide food and
water in case of flight being delayed by
more than three hours;
(b) if so, details in this regard;
(c) whether Director-General, Civil
Aviation (DGCA) has issued instruction
to private airlines to follow the Supreme
Court direction; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Air traffic expansion in India
*515. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA: Will the Minister of CIVIL
A VIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Airports Authority of
India (AAI) has sought more funds to keep
pace with fleet and traffic expansion
expected in India in the next few years;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the air traffic from non-
metro airports and greenfield airports is
likely to grow manifold; and
(d) if so, the plans of Government/AAI
to maintain infrastructure growth to meet
air traffic demand?
Detailed project proposal of
Karnataka
*516. DR. VIJAY MALLYA: Will the
Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT AND
HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Karnataka has submitted to the Central
Government a detailed project proposal
comprising construction, improvement and
development of four major roads in the State
at a total cost of Rs. 59 crore under Central
Road Funds in December, 2009;
(b) the present stage of consideration
of these proposals; and
(c) by when Government's approval to
these proposals would be communicated
to the State Government?
Revisiting the Anganwadi system
*517. PROF. SAIF-UD-DIN SOZ: Will
the Minister of WOMEN AND CHILD
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Minister is aware that
many people feel convinced that the
Anganwadi system had not yielded
advantages that were expected; and
(b) if so, whether the Minister would
revisit the scheme and ensure its
implementation on scientific lines?

149
Poverty line definition
*518. SHRI A VINASH PANDE: Will
the PRIME MINISTER be pleased to
state:
(a) in what manner Government defines
the poverty line for the purposes of
planning;
(b) whether some international
organisations, including the United Nations
Development Programme (UNDP) and
World Bank, have formulated norms to
define the poverty line;
(c) if so, the details thereof;
(d) whether Government is planning to
redefine the poverty line in accordance with
recommendations mentioned in part (c); and
(e) if so, the details thereof?
Haj House near Shamshabad Airport
in Hyderabad
*519. SHRIMATI T. RATNA BAI:
Will the Minister of EXTERNAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government has made any
progress on the construction of Haj House
near Shamshabad Airport in  Hyderabad;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the progress made in this direction
so far and the amount spent so far?
Safety of Tarapore Nuclear Power
Plant
*520. SHRI P. RAJEEVE: Will the
PRIME MINISTER be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that at the
Tarapore Nuclear Power Plant, units 1& 2,
are Boiling Water Reactors (BWRs), similar
to ones at Fukushima, Japan;
(b) the magnitude of earthquake on the
Richter Scale that units  1 & 2 at Tarapore
are equipped to withstand;
(c) whether these units at Tarapore are
equipped to withstand an earthquake
measuring 9.0 on the Richter Scale, similar
to the one that struck Japan on March 11,
2011; and
(d) if not, the steps being taken to
ensure that these units are equipped to
withstand earthquakes of this magnitude?
N
EW DELHI; V .K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 2nd September, 2011 Secretary-General.
Bhadra 11, 1933 (Saka)
